description: This file defines the JmesPath\Env class, responsible for environment-based configuration and runtime creation for JMESPath expression evaluation. It provides static methods to search data, create runtime instances based on environment variables, clean compiled files, and access environment variables within the system.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for environment-based runtime selection, search execution, and cleanup operations in the JMESPath PHP library.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a JMESPath expression against provided data, initializing the runtime if necessary.

methods.name: createRuntime
methods.description: Creates and returns a runtime object for JMESPath evaluation based on environment variables.

methods.name: cleanCompileDir
methods.description: Removes all compiled JMESPath PHP files from the designated compile directory or temporary directory.

methods.name: getEnvVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable from $_SERVER, $_ENV, or getenv().
